# `company.import_runs`

Import runs: one file imported for one kind, previewed then run in slices. Only state, batch and version change.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this run. |
| `kind` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | Import kind (customer, vendor, item, account, term...). |
| `mode` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | create, update or upsert. |
| `atomic` | BOOLEAN | no | — | — | — | — | True when the first refusal undoes the whole run. |
| `state` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | previewed, running, stopped, waiting, done, cancelled, rolled_back or failed (an atomic undo refused). |
| `source` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | — | — | The named origin of the file; keys are unique within it. |
| `mapping` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON of the mapping used: columns to input paths, key columns, formats. |
| `attachment_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Attachment the file came from; null for pasted text. |
| `file_name` | VARCHAR(255) | yes | — | — | — | — | File name or label as given. |
| `file_sha256` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | SHA-256 of the file as read. |
| `encoding` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | Encoding the file was read in. |
| `delimiter` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | Cell delimiter the file was read with. |
| `row_count` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Data rows (a document counts once). |
| `stop_after_refusals` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Refusals in one call after which the run stops itself. |
| `batch_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | batches.id | The batch its writes belong to; null until it first writes. |
| `reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why, as given at preview. |
| `version` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Optimistic-concurrency version of the run. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time of the preview. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal that previewed it. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface it was previewed through. |
| `updated_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time of the last state change. |
